from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import FormulaRule
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/CF_12196/1_CF_12196_input.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Conditional format: highlight cells in C3:G6 green when the order value
# is greater than 75% of the weekly delivered amount in column A for that row.
green_fill = PatternFill(fill_type='solid', fgColor='00FF00')

rule = FormulaRule(
    formula=['C3>$A3*0.75'],
    fill=green_fill
)

ws.conditional_formatting.add('C3:G6', rule)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
